title: Luciferase Reporter Assay for NF-kB Activation
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Prepare luciferase assay reagents
steps.instruction: Using the Promega luciferase assay kit, dissolve the lyophilized substrate in the supplied assay buffer as instructed, dilute the 5X cell‑culture lysis reagent to working concentration, and dispense 11 mL of luciferase assay reagent (100 µL per well), 4.6 mL of lysis reagent (30 µL per well), and 6.5 mL PBS (50 µL per well) into a NEST 1‑Well Reservoir (195 mL).

substeps.instruction: Dissolve lyophilized luciferase substrate in assay buffer per manufacturer’s instructions.
Dilute 5X lysis reagent to working concentration.
Aliquot 11 mL luciferase assay reagent (100 µL per sample) into the reservoir.
Aliquot 4.6 mL lysis reagent (30 µL per sample) into the reservoir.
Aliquot 6.5 mL PBS (50 µL per sample) into the reservoir for washing.

steps.title: Remove culture medium
steps.instruction: From the working 96‑well plate, transfer the supernatant (culture medium) to a waste container.

steps.title: Add lysis reagent
steps.instruction: Transfer 30 µL of the prepared lysis reagent from the reservoir to each well of the working plate.

steps.title: Incubate lysed cells
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate at room temperature for 3 minutes to allow cell lysis.

steps.title: Add luciferase substrate
steps.instruction: Transfer 100 µL of the prepared luciferase assay reagent from the reservoir to each well of the working plate.

steps.title: Measure luminescence
steps.instruction: Read the luminescence of the plate on a microplate reader (off‑deck).
